summary.en: Taliban forces are confronting Pakistani security troops along the Kurram border, while Pakistan has halted trade at two Iran crossings and a dispute over the Zangali checkpost is affecting Torkham operations as it deepens a defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey. The United Nations warns Afghanistan is one step away from famine and the Taliban has opened a road to China that faces security hurdles. Iran remains open to US talks under a Pakistan-brokered deal and a new opium-related hub is emerging in Afghan borderlands with Iran and Pakistan after the Taliban ban. 1,794 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Talibanstyrker konfronterer pakistanske sikkerhetstroppere langs Kurram-grensen, mens Pakistan har stanset handelen ved to iranske grenseoverganger og en tvist om Zangali-sjekkposten påvirker Torkham-operasjonene mens landet utdyper et forsvarspakt med Saudi-Arabia og Tyrkia. FN advarer om at Afghanistan er ett skritt fra hungersnød og Taliban har åpnet en vei til Kina som møter sikkerhetsutfordringer. Iran er fortsatt åpent for amerikanske samtaler under en Pakistan-meklet avtale, og et nytt opiummessig knutepunkt vokser frem i afghanske grenseområder med Iran og Pakistan etter Talibans forbud. 1,794 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
